title: Hackers claim millions of patient records stolen during data breach at healthcare giant McKesson | TechCrunch
summary: A prolific hacking group has taken credit for last week’s cyberattack against U.S. pharmaceutical distribution giant McKesson, leading to the latest spill of highly sensitive health data by an American healthcare company in recent months.
